scene.ofreeRecent: the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; a tiny neighborhood repair cafe with a sunlit workbench and a hand-cranked mechanical ticket dispenser — she frees a jammed paper roll from the dispenser using two wooden clothes pegs; a dim jazz bar with a grand piano — standing; a quiet seaside tidal-rock bathing terrace with shallow clear pools — she uses a small floating balance to divide smooth pebbles into equal piles; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — sitting on the ground; an empty sunny laundromat folding counter beside a large round washing-machine door — she compares two freshly paired socks by folding them into equal rectangles; a rocky coast path with tide pools — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; the grassy edge of a floating island high in the sky — lying on her front; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; a shopping mall atrium with a fountain and glass railings — carries her keepsake low at her side; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — tears a finished page out of a notebook
